headline: Security and Compliance Intern Candidate | Cyber Security Analyst
summary: Computer Science graduate (UC Irvine, 2026) seeking OpenSesame's remote Summer 2027 Security and Compliance Internship. Built and operate a production iOS app, owning its security and privacy controls: access control, authentication, data deletion, and retention. Builds with AI (prompt engineering, RAG); eager to learn ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance.
skills: Access Control (RBAC), IAM, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, Data Privacy & Retention, Secrets Management, Secure SDLC, Input Validation, Rate Limiting, SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, Packet Analysis
Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), ETL & Data Engineering, Feature Engineering
RSA, Elliptic-Curve Cryptography (ECC), SHA-256 Hashing, TLS
Wireshark, Burp Suite, Firebase App Check (App Attest), Docker, Git
AWS, Google Cloud Platform (Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Functions), Serverless Architecture, REST APIs
Python, JavaScript / Node.js, Swift, C/C++, Java, SQL
communicai_bullets: Implemented privacy controls including full account and data deletion and scheduled data-retention cleanup, and kept all credentials and secrets out of version control.
Designed role-based access-control rules that block insecure direct object references (IDOR), privilege escalation, and message spoofing; validated with 36 adversarial unit tests.

Implemented multi-provider authentication (Sign in with Apple with nonce + SHA-256 hashing, Google OAuth, and email/password with server-enforced verification) and Firebase App Check (App Attest) on every backend request.

Built server-authoritative Cloud Functions enforcing authentication, input validation, and per-user and global rate limiting (5 rewrites per user/day); added server-side Apple receipt verification to prevent subscription fraud.
